dates.note: NO SOURCE READ HERE STATES A YEAR FOR THE FRANÇOIS I CAMPAIGN THIS NODE VALUES, AND NONE IS INVENTED. The protection notice gives centuries only. The exemplar's `year` is therefore left null rather than filled with a remembered date.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. THE THINNEST SURVEY IN THIS CLUSTER, AND THE GAP IS WORTH NAMING RATHER THAN PAPERING OVER. The domaine national notice is a protection instrument: it states the decor techniques, two authors and the decree, and no material, storey count, bay count or dimension. Worse, its author field names only Le Nôtre and Le Vau - seventeenth-century men - for a palace whose Renaissance work is the reason this node cites it. No Inventaire (IA) notice for Fontainebleau was found by the queries run here, and one is the obvious next thing to look for. No measurement is recorded because the notice states no figure. No rights line was read, so no `rights_evidence`.
